use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: C2 JU
If the Retained TN and the Dropped TN will decorrelate when subjected to the decorrelation criteria once, the correlation shall be rejected.
If the C2 JU receives a J7.2 Correlation message while holding Operational Contingency Constraints (OCCs) on both tracks or conflicting IDs, it shall reject the correlation.

If the C2 JU receives a J7.2 message with RV field set to value 3 (manually initiated correlation), it shall automatically accept the requested correlation unless one of the following restrictions applies: different E/C or existing E/C conflict, one simulated and one live track, or both locally derived real-time tracks — in which case the correlation shall be rejected.

If there is an OCC on the Dropped TN with RV field set to value 0 and the new Dropped TN has no correlation constraint, reverse correlation shall be transmitted; if both Retained TN and Dropped TN have an OCC, the correlation shall be rejected.
If the RV field is set to value 0, it indicates a reverse correlation would be acceptable; if set to value 1, it indicates a reverse correlation request would be rejected.
When a correlation request is rejected for manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
When the C2 JU recognizes that two tracks being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation, it shall initiate action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation.
If the C2 JU has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, it assumes R².

If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive; a C2 JU receiving such a message on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
If a C2 JU without R² for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to value 0 has that track locally updated by a new nonreal-time report, it shall assume R² for that track.

If J2 messages are not received subsequent to this action and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.

When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert, the operator shall have the following manual actions for attempting resolution: (1) update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; (2) initiate J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message; (3) initiate J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message; (4) change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; (5) decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing assignment of a new track number to local data; (6) clear operator alert.

missing_aspects: Main-flow step numbers to anchor each exception branch are not provided in the source evidence.
Complete exception rule for correlation of a common local track to a remote track (evidence fragment only).
Recovery/continuation after automatic correlation rejections (only manual-correlation rejection has a documented operator alert).
main_flow claims with step numbers are not provided; each alternative path must diverge from a specific main-flow step, and no such step exists in the current context.

claims.content: All C² JUs that initiate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic decorrelation capability.

scope_contract.goal_statement: All C² JUs that initiate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic decorrelation capability.

claims.content: If no tentative correlation is found on the initial test, the new local track is transmitted.
If a new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test, the new local track is transmitted.
If the automatic correlation test fails during execution, the system assigns a new Track Number (TN B) to the local track and reports TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message with an initial ID of Pending.
After successful decorrelation execution, the system establishes the original local track (TN A) as a remote track.
The C2 JU must have initially achieved Active status, or returned to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
The C2 JU must be capable of assuming R² for air or surface tracks.
The C2 JU must have an automatic decorrelation capability for real-time air or surface tracks it initiates.

After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, a C2 JU capable of assuming reporting responsibility for air or surface tracks that initiates a real-time air or surface track shall not transmit that track until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.

On receipt of each J2 or J3 message on a common local track (TN A), the C2 JU performs automatic decorrelation tests for that track. The correlation process commences with comparing locally derived sensor data (position, velocity, and altitude) with the data received on the interface.

When the position/other data in a PPLI meet the decorrelation criteria—specifically, after receipt of 2 consecutive remote track reports, the remote track falls outside 1.5 times the maximum correlation distance—the C2 JU executes automatic decorrelation for common local track TN A.

The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks when local/remote data indicate: (1) an ID difference that constitutes a conflict; (2) different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current; (3) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks; or (4) either track has Strength greater than 1.
Using its automatic correlation capability, the C2 JU automatically tests the local track once for correlation against remote tracks, not against common local tracks.
When the automatic correlation test fails, the C2 JU assigns a new Track Number (TN B) to the local track.
The C2 JU establishes the original local track (TN A) as a remote track.
After decorrelation, the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field are both reported as No Statement.
If no tentative correlation is found on the initial test, the new local track is transmitted.
After successful correlation testing, if a new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test, the new local track shall be transmitted.
The C2 JU reports TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message, with an initial ID of Pending. The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds.
The C2 JU initiates a real-time air or surface track.

quality_flags.detail: No supported claim produced from frozen evidence for slot 'alternative_flow'

[trigger_preconditions_coverage] The Trigger lets the C2 JU initiate a real-time air or surface track, but the goal EC-G-001 requires all initiating C2 JUs to have automatic decorrelation capability. Preconditions only cover Active status and R² assumption capability; they do not state that the C2 JU has the automatic decorrelation/correlation capability on which the Main Flow depends. Therefore an independent capability state is missing before the Trigger. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (No cited evidence supports the added detail about publishing real-time air or surface tracks; only initiating is supported.))

[trigger_preconditions_coverage] Preconditions establish Active status, reporting-responsibility capability, and automatic decorrelation capability, but main flow step 5 relies on an automatic correlation capability: 'Using its automatic correlation capability...'. This capability must already hold before the C2 JU initiates a real-time track and begins the correlation/decorrelation flow, so it is a missing precondition.

inconsistency_hints: Postcondition EC-PO-002 requires the branch where a new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test. Main Flow Step 5 (index 4) states the local track is tested 'once' for correlation, and the flow then handles a single automatic-correlation-test-failure by assigning TN B. There is no Main Flow step for the follow-up/next test after a tentative correlation, so this postcondition is not reachable.

The goal claim frames the use case as initiating real-time air or surface tracks, and the canonical success scenario requires the C2 JU to 'initiate' a track and then have it published. The main_flow is the publish-after-correlation flow: it begins with an existing common local track (TN A) and Active status, performs automatic decorrelation/correlation tests, and only creates TN B as a result of a failed correlation test. There is no general main_flow step for initiating a real-time air/surface track. The goal is therefore too broad and conflates an initiation/upstream process with this publication use case.

The trigger initiates real-time air/surface tracks, and the goal requires every C2 JU that initiates such tracks to have an automatic decorrelation capability, but the preconditions only assert Active status and R²-assumption capability; the automatic decorrelation capability is not established before the trigger.

Postcondition EC-PO-003 (no tentative correlation on initial test -> new local track transmitted) is not reachable from the main flow: EC-PO-003 is absent from main_flow evidence cards, and the flow only has a tentative-then-fail branch (step 9) and a failed-correlation/decorrelation branch (steps 6/10), not a clean no-tentative-correlation publication branch.

Main flow step 1 restates the Active-status precondition and introduces land tracks; it does not continue from the trigger's initiation of an air/surface track. The first main-flow step should act on the initiated track rather than restarting from the Active-status/TDS-recovery condition.
